events.title: FIND ALIEN! – Steam Next Fest 2026!
events.summary: FIND ALIEN! is joining Steam Next Fest (October 19–26)!Hello, everyone! We're Team Newmatic! Haven't tried FIND ALIEN! yet? Disguise yourself as a human, sneak past B.A.R.D. agents, solve puzzles with friends, and rescue the captured Tumai!The free demo is available now on Steam!Take on the challenge solo or team up with up to 3 friends for some co-op fun! We'd love to hear what you think! Whether it's something you enjoyed, something that could be improved, or a new idea, feel free to share it

events.title: FIND ALIEN! – Demo Out Now!!
events.summary: FIND ALIEN! – Rescue Your Teammates! FIND ALIEN! is a cooperative stealth action game for up to 4 players. You're an alien! Disguise yourself as a human and sneak into a heavily guarded facility while avoiding the watchful eyes of B.A.R.D. agents! Team up with your friends, solve various puzzles, and rescue your captured fellow aliens, the Tumai! Key FeaturesPlay Together! Play solo or team up with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.Perfect Disguise! Copy the appearance of nearby humans
